features.name: Data Directory

features.name: Document Import
features.description: Users can import .txt and .md files via ImportPanel with file picker
features.evidence: ImportPanel resolves the picked file with webUtils.getPathForFile and sends the path through documents:import. The list refreshes and the new document is selected. Service check: import of notes.md returns metadata and stores content.

features.name: Document Detail with Content
features.description: DocumentDetail shows full document content, metadata, and delete button
features.evidence: View Content loads text through documents:get-content. Delete removes metadata and content/<id>.txt. Service check: getDocumentContent returns the file body, and delete clears it.

features.name: Basic Persistence
features.description: Imported documents persist across app restarts via filesystem storage
features.evidence: Import writes documents-meta.json and content/<id>.txt under userData/knowledge-base-data. A new DocumentService on the same directory reloads the list and body; delete clears both. App calls refreshDocuments() on mount, and indexing status reports documentsLoaded from that file. Service check: tests/document-persistence.test.ts.
